Get ESPN MCH / WCH Teams (site_v2) – alias for espn_mch_teams()

Source: R/espn_ncaa_hockey.R
espn_mch_teams_site.Rd

Get ESPN MCH / WCH Teams (site_v2) – alias for espn_mch_teams()

Usage

espn_mch_teams_site(limit = 1000, ...)

espn_wch_teams_site(limit = 1000, ...)

Arguments

limit

Maximum number of teams (ESPN limit; default 1000, as sportsdataverse-py).

...

Reserved for forward compatibility.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble with one row per MCH team. This is identical to the output of teams.

col_nametypedescription
abbreviationcharacterTeam abbreviation.
display_namecharacterTeam display name.
espn_team_idintegerESPN team identifier.
teamcharacterTeam location/city name.
logocharacterLight-background logo URL.
logo_darkcharacterDark-background logo URL.
logos_href_3characterLogo variant 3 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_4characterLogo variant 4 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_5characterLogo variant 5 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_6characterLogo variant 6 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_7characterLogo variant 7 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_8characterLogo variant 8 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_9characterLogo variant 9 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_10characterLogo variant 10 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_11characterLogo variant 11 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_12characterLogo variant 12 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_13characterLogo variant 13 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
logos_href_14characterLogo variant 14 URL (ESPN sends a varying number of logos per team).
mascotcharacterTeam mascot/nickname.
nicknamecharacterTeam nickname.
short_namecharacterShort team display name.

Details

League slug mens-college-hockey; season is the END year (2026 = 2025-26). Same ESPN helper as espn_nhl_teams_site(); columns verified against a captured MCH body.

espn_wch_teams_site() is the same wrapper for women's college hockey (league slug womens-college-hockey): same arguments, same columns.

See also

family_espn_mch lists every function in this family.

teams which this function wraps.

Author

Saiem Gilani
